best_candidate = None
best_score = -1
for c in candidates:
    yaw_diff = abs(c["yaw"] - 0.701)
    if c["fits_open_fingers"] and yaw_diff < 0.2 and c["score"] > best_score:
        best_candidate = c
        best_score = c["score"]

grasp_result = grasp(best_candidate)
if not grasp_result["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp red_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "red_pen")
if not spots:
    raise RuntimeError("No free spot in green_case")

spot = spots[0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=0.701)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check_result = check("red_pen", "green_case")
if not check_result["satisfied"]:
    raise RuntimeError("red_pen not properly placed in green_case")
